name: 開始と目標の範囲を添えた現在値の集計カード
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese progress summary card based on the supplied references. The original Asana crop is primary for card geometry, border, alignment, and the hierarchy of the three values; the Japanese preview is primary for the exact localized text and compact typography. Make a single white card that fills a 312×100 canvas (about 3.12:1), with only a very small outer margin. Do not create a dashboard, extra cards, labels, or broad blank bands.

Use a thin light-gray outline with gently rounded corners. Center the content vertically and horizontally in three tiers: at the top, the small muted-gray label 「現在の値」; directly below it, a prominent bold dark 「40%」; at the bottom, a compact horizontal range with muted 「10%」, a small upward-right arrow, and dark 「100%」. Preserve the spacing and simple sans-serif style shown in the Japanese preview. Keep the card background pure white, with no shadows, icons other than the small upward-right arrow, or additional wording.
reviewNotes: Registered v001 with stored:true and catalogUpdated:true. The 2213x711 PNG is 3.113:1, matching the 3.000:1 original crop and 3.120:1 mock. The exact Japanese label, 40% current value, 10% to 100% range, arrow, and rounded border were visually checked. SHA-256 matches manifest/catalog; metadata includes prompt and references; refreshed HTML includes it and canonical image is open. Retains counted:false as variant of LH09-0218.
